attempt_accounting: reserve_attempt is atomic and executes immediately before opener; every first attempt and retry consumes one unit
pre_request_gate: mandatory quota read/reservation before every Open API attempt
hard_stop: global_usage >= 9500 pauses acquisition; global_usage > 10000 is invalid
cross_day_policy: PAUSED_QUOTA checkpoint then next KST day resume
configuration_gap: existing default quota reserve is 0; execution must explicitly construct/configure reserve=500 before any Open API request
